name: tradingagents-portable
description: Delegate TradingAgents research and inspect the completed read-only dossier.

interface.shortDescription: Run upstream research and inspect its final dossier.
interface.longDescription: A research-only adapter that delegates arbitrary Yahoo-style instruments to upstream TradingAgentsGraph and presents the completed result as a read-only dossier. Includes a verified credential-free synthetic ORCL fixture; live provider execution is credential-gated and runtime-unverified.
defaultPrompt: Run the verified credential-free ORCL fixture.
Delegate a Yahoo-style instrument to upstream TradingAgentsGraph when its environment is configured.
Inspect a completed run through the merged read-only dossier.
